children: Overview
U.S. factory-built home maker's fiscal Q2 revenue rose 17.9%, beating analyst expectations
Net income per diluted share increased 9% year-over-year
Company repurchased about $30 mln in stock during the quarter
Outlook
Company expects healthy backlogs to support operations during seasonally slower winter months
Company expects materials inflation to remain a challenge in coming quarters
Company sees data center workforce housing orders contributing to future backlog
Result Drivers
HOME SALES VOLUME AND PRICING - Co attributed revenue growth to higher home sales volume and increased average selling price per home
INSURANCE PREMIUM RETURN - One-time $7 mln insurance premium return boosted net income per diluted share by $0.70
